data.long_meaning: Qaneez is an Arabic name that means 'pure and chaste', symbolizing modesty and innocence. It is a name that reflects a person's moral character and uprightness. The name Qaneez carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qaneez usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Qaneez belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaneez total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
